title: Hardware-Conditioned Generative Channel Modeling: A Diffusion-Based Approach for Location and Hardware-Aware Wireless Dataset Synthesis

contributions.purpose: 让扩散信道生成感知硬件配置
contributions.mechanism: H-cDDIM:在 cDDIM 上加解耦条件模块(DCM),对 9 维多模态条件(位置+天线几何/间距,分 5 组)分模态嵌入再融合
contributions.evaluation: UC/UE 天线配置(ULA/planar、0.4λ/0.5λ 间距)
contributions.domain: 无线信道生成 / 扩散模型
contributions.source_quote: This paper introduces the Hardware-Conditioned Diffusion Model (H-cDDIM), a novel framework that extends conditional diffusion models to incorporate a rich, multi-modal conditioning vector.

contributions.mechanism: 用 DeepMIMO 系统性变化天线配置生成数据集
contributions.source_quote: We propose a methodology to create a diverse training dataset by systematically varying antenna array configurations using the DeepMIMO generator.

contributions.mechanism: 用 Wasserstein/MMD/KS 比对生成与真值分布
contributions.evaluation: 容量 Wasserstein 0.1403 vs 基线 0.6762(约 79% 改善),Frobenius 0.1376 vs 0.3862;但 KS 容量 0.1976 反而劣于基线 0.1701,MMD 容量 0.2045≈0.2064 几乎持平
contributions.source_quote: H-cDDIM significantly outperforms the baseline in matching the ground truth distribution, with a 79% improvement in Wasserstein distance for channel capacity.

self_declared_provenance.quote: a novel framework that extends the state-of-the-art by incorporating a rich, multi-modal conditioning vector... extending the state-of-the-art from location-aware to hardware-aware generative
Our proposed model adapts the conditioning mechanism of a baseline cDDIM to handle this mixed-type input.

notes: trade-off/择优报数红旗:头条"79% 改善"只在 Wasserstein 成立;同表 KS 容量统计 0.1976 反劣于基线 0.1701、MMD 容量 0.2045 vs 0.2064 几乎无差,论文只强调 Wasserstein。限制:固定天线数(BS32/UE4)、单一 DeepMIMO 户外遮挡场景、仅 mmWave,泛化窄。训练数据为 DeepMIMO 仿真(领域惯例,非造假)。accept。
